# intenter approve

Remember the effects of an evaluated command

Creates an approval from an audit event (the event id printed by the hook or
shown by `intenter history`), recording the effects that command resolved to
and a fingerprint of every mutable input the resolution read. By default the
approval is exact (these targets); --semantic approves the effect envelope so
an equivalent command with different spelling matches too. Either kind stops
matching as soon as the resolved effects or a fingerprint change. Only a fully
resolved command that no safety rule objects to can be approved: a blocked
command, one a rule always asks about, or one Intenter could not resolve
is refused.

## Usage

```text
intenter approve <event-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter approve 12
intenter approve 12 --semantic --note "test runs may write build/"
```

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--note` `<string>` | — | a note to remember why this was approved |
| `--semantic` | — | approve the effect envelope rather than these exact targets |
